title: A false done travels down a chain of agents; a receipt check stops most of it
question: If a build agent says done on an unbacked claim, does the next agent question it?
summary_line: A reviewer agent followed the build agent's word; a receipt check from an unchangeable record cut false release most.
headline: Of {{F007.c.claims.n}} claims, {{F007.c.qwen_g0_hosted.d}} had no backing. On the build agent's word alone, a false done reached release on {{F007.c.qwen_g0_hosted}} (Qwen 3.5 9B) and {{F007.c.gemma_g0_hosted}} (Gemma 4 26B); with a receipt check as advice, {{F007.c.qwen_g2_hosted.n}} and {{F007.c.gemma_g2_hosted.n}}. Local pair: {{F007.c.qwen_g0_local.n}} and {{F007.c.gemma_g0_local.n}} down to {{F007.c.qwen_g2_local.n}} and {{F007.c.gemma_g2_local.n}}.
plain_meaning: The next agent never questioned the one before: after a hold, release happened {{F007.c.hold_released.n}} times. A check against a record the agent cannot change helped most.
limits: One scripted build message; run records withheld, so seals cannot be checked against content.
The audit moved the hosted gate's false pass from {{F007.c.gate_false}} to {{F007.c.gate_false_audit}}.
